name: SMD Re-Work Station, 270 W
tagline: 270 W hot-air SMD re-work station, 100 °C to 420 °C, up to 24 L/min airflow, three nozzles supplied.
description: The Vartech 850 A is a 270 W hot-air station for removing and refitting surface-mount components such as QFP and SOP packages. Temperature is adjustable from 100 °C to 420 °C and the air volume is linearly adjustable up to 24 L/min, from a low-noise pump in its own enclosure. Heating is quick and the station is ESD safe. Three nozzles are supplied; further nozzles and tips are sold separately.
features: 270 W hot-air station - 100 °C to 420 °C
Air volume linearly adjustable, up to 24 L/min
Powerful start and rapid heating
Suits QFP and SOP ICs
Pump in its own enclosure for low noise
ESD-safe; 3 nozzles supplied, more available separately

name: Digital SMD Re-Work Station, 320 W
tagline: 320 W digital hot-air SMD re-work station, 100 °C to 480 °C, PID closed loop, auto cooling and auto sleep.
description: The Vartech 850 D is a 320 W digital hot-air re-work station for long hours of SMD work. A 3-digit display shows the temperature, which is held between 100 °C and 480 °C by a PID closed-loop thermocouple sensor and set with soft-touch up and down keys. The air volume is linearly adjustable up to 24 L/min from a low-noise diaphragm pump. Cooling is automatic: delivery is deferred at start-up and the station switches itself off once the temperature falls below 100 °C. Three nozzles are supplied.
features: 320 W - 100 °C to 480 °C with PID closed-loop thermocouple control
3-digit display; soft-touch up/down keys
Air volume linearly adjustable, up to 24 L/min; low-noise diaphragm pump
Suits BGA, CSP, QFP, PLCC, SOP and other surface-mount ICs
Intelligent cooling, deferred air delivery and auto power-off below 100 °C
Auto sleep function
3 nozzles supplied, more available separately

name: Digital SMD Re-Work Station, 580 W
tagline: 580 W digital hot-air SMD station, 100 °C to 450 °C, up to 100 L/min airflow, handle sensor with auto standby.
description: The Vartech 857 D is a 580 W digital hot-air re-work station with a 3-digit LED display. Temperature is adjustable from 100 °C to 450 °C and the air volume linearly up to 100 L/min, delivered by a double vortex blower as a soft rotating flow that is gentle on small parts. The heater reaches the set temperature in about 3 seconds, and the station stays stable when the supply voltage varies. A sensor in the handle starts the station when you pick it up and puts it on standby when it is left idle, and cooling is automatic. Noise is below 78 dB.
features: 580 W - 100 °C to 450 °C with a 3-digit LED display
Air volume linearly adjustable, up to 100 L/min
Double vortex blower - soft rotating airflow, gentle on fragile parts
Reaches the set temperature in about 3 seconds
Handle sensor with auto standby and automatic cooling
Stable when the supply voltage varies; noise below 78 dB

name: Lead-Free SMD Re-Work Station, 1000 W
tagline: 1000 W lead-free hot-air SMD station, 100 °C to 500 °C, three programmable channels, 1 to 120 L/min airflow.
description: The Vartech 861 DW is a 1000 W hot-air re-work station for lead-free SMD work. Temperature is adjustable from 100 °C to 500 °C and the airflow from 1 to 120 L/min. Three programmable channels (CH1, CH2, CH3) each store a temperature and an airflow setting. A closed-loop sensor with microcomputer zero-trigger control keeps the temperature steady regardless of airflow, a brushless vortex fan gives step-less airflow adjustment, and a ceramic heater is used. Password and key lock protect the settings, and a magnetic switch in the stand puts the station to sleep when the handle is placed on it.
features: 1000 W - 100 °C to 500 °C, closed-loop sensor control
3 programmable channels, each with its own temperature and airflow
Airflow 1 to 120 L/min, step-less, from a brushless vortex fan
Password protection and key lock
Magnetic switch in the stand starts sleep mode automatically; parameters can be set while asleep
Ceramic heater with auto cooling; digital display

name: 2-in-1 Soldering and SMD Re-Work Station, 270 W + 50 W
tagline: 2-in-1 station: 270 W hot-air SMD re-work and a 50 W soldering iron, switched independently, ESD safe.
description: The Vartech 700 ESD puts a 270 W hot-air SMD re-work section and a 50 W soldering section in one unit. The hot air runs from 100 °C to 420 °C with airflow up to 24 L/min; the soldering iron runs from 200 °C to 480 °C with ±2 °C stability. The two sections have separate switches, so they can be used together or one at a time, and the pump is enclosed for low noise. It is built for long hours on an assembly or repair line. Three nozzles and a pointed tip are supplied.
features: Hot air and soldering iron in one unit, switched separately or used together
Hot-air section: 270 W, 100 °C to 420 °C, up to 24 L/min
Soldering section: 50 W, 200 °C to 480 °C, ±2 °C stability
Air volume linearly adjustable; pump enclosed for low noise
ESD-safe
3 nozzles and a pointed tip supplied

name: 2-in-1 Soldering and SMD Re-Work Station, 580 W + 50 W
tagline: 2-in-1 station: 580 W hot-air SMD re-work and a 50 W soldering iron, with a digital display.
description: The Vartech 706 puts a 580 W hot-air section and a 50 W soldering section in one unit. The hot air runs from 100 °C to 450 °C with airflow up to 50 L/min from a brushless vortex fan, the LED display shows temperature to 1 °C, and a closed-loop sensor controls the heat. The soldering iron runs from 200 °C to 480 °C with ±2 °C stability. The sections have separate switches so they can run together or singly, and automatic cooling protects the hot-air handle and the heating element. Three nozzles and a pointed tip are supplied.

name: SMD Hot Tweezer for Soldering Station 937
tagline: SMD hot tweezer for the Vartech 937 station: 50 W ceramic heater, 200 °C to 400 °C.
description: The Vartech 989 is a hot tweezer attachment that plugs into a Vartech 937 soldering station (the earlier 936 ESD stations also work; the 936 A and 936 AD do not). Two 25 W ceramic heaters heat the twin tips together, so a surface-mount resistor, capacitor or SOP package can be lifted or fitted by touching both sides at once, without heating the parts around it. The temperature range is 200 °C to 400 °C.
features: Attachment for the Vartech 937 station - not compatible with the 936 A or 936 AD
50 W (2 × 25 W, 24 V AC) ceramic heater
Twin tips heat the component directly, leaving neighbouring parts alone
For removing and fitting SMD resistors, capacitors and SOP parts
Light handle; ESD-safe, tip to ground resistance below 2 Ω; different tips available

name: Pre-Heater for BGA Re-Work System, Temperature Controlled
tagline: 460 W pre-heater for BGA re-work, 120 °C to 250 °C, hot or cool air.
description: The Vartech 853 ESD is a 460 W temperature-controlled pre-heater that warms the underside of a board during BGA re-work, so the hot-air station has less heat to add from above. It reaches 250 °C in about 10 seconds, holds the output temperature with a built-in sensor, and can blow either hot or cool air to pre-heat or to cool a chip. Used together with a hot-air re-work station, it handles BGA and other flat ICs.
features: Reaches 250 °C in about 10 seconds
Built-in temperature sensor for a stable output
Hot or cool air selectable - pre-heat or cool a chip
Used with a re-work station for BGA and other flat ICs

name: BGA Re-Work System Fixture (Large)
tagline: Large PCB holding fixture for BGA re-work, takes boards up to 305 mm.
description: The Vartech 800 L is a fixture that holds a printed circuit board during BGA re-work. A 850-series hot-air station connects at the top and the 853 pre-heater sits below the board, and the Vartech 381 A vacuum pickup can be used to lift and hold the component. The fixture is 400 × 300 × 117 mm with an adjustable height and takes boards up to 305 mm. The smaller 800 S is available for small boards.
features: Holds the PCB steady for BGA re-work
Fixture 400 × 300 × 117 mm; boards up to 305 mm, open on one side
Height adjustable
Hot-air station mounts above; 853 pre-heater sits below the board
Works with the 381 A vacuum pickup; smaller 800 S available for small boards

name: Smoke Absorber / Solder Fume Extractor
tagline: Bench-top solder fume extractor, 16 W, about 1 m³/min, replaceable carbon filter.
description: The Vartech 493 ESD is a bench-top fume extractor that draws solder fumes away from the work area. The adjustable-angle head moves about 1 m³ of air a minute (0.93 to 1.07 m³/min) from a low-noise fan using 16 W. The replaceable filter combines urethane with activated carbon and must be changed periodically depending on use; two spare filters are supplied with the unit. It is an anti-static (ESD-safe) type.
features: Draws fumes away at 0.93 to 1.07 m³/min; 16 W
Adjustable angle, easy to place or move
Low-noise fan
Replaceable urethane and activated-carbon filter - 3 filters supplied in total
Anti-static (ESD-safe) construction
